author: SickProdigy
description: Protected fixed-supply ERC-20 deployments on Base Sepolia through CryptoWallet.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores public test-token deployment drafts linked to Discord user IDs and public wallet addresses. It never stores wallet keys, recovery material, or credentials.
install_msg: TokenFactory is Base Sepolia-only. Load CryptoWallet first. The bot owner must verify the pinned factory and run `[p]tokenfactoryset deployment enable` before members can confirm deployments from `[p]tokenfactory create`. Use `[p]tokenfactoryset deployment pause` as the emergency stop.
short: Protected fixed-supply Base Sepolia token deployments
